highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 improves image-subset sampling, filter-cache consistency, and mask-filtered glyph rendering on the existing Skia m158 engine.

bullets.detail: Filtered images and Ganesh draws retain clamping and logical texture bounds when AA or MSAA expands sampling beyond image geometry. Minified, skewed, and non-pixel-aligned transparent-border draws no longer rely on insufficient padding that can expose unrelated backing-texture pixels.

Cache-key equality now compares the same byte representation used by hashing, accounting for signed zero, subnormal values, and cached matrix type bits instead of relying on numerical matrix equality.

bullets.lead: Respect regenerated glyph formats and bounds
bullets.detail: Mask filtering uses the reloaded glyph's path and requires matching byte-per-pixel masks before copying overlap. Incompatible masks produce cleared output, while clipped embossed glyphs use full plane strides, preventing stale-path rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
